pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, multi-edged polygonal patches with high-frequency serrated edge gradients. The geometry is characterized by sharp, non-linear boundaries and dark brown interior pigmentation that tapers into cream margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected network of light tan pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trilateral and quadrilateral configurations with relatively uniform pixel thickness, except where constricted at the vertices of large flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck, forming a consistent serrated profile against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, raised, and textured mass is visible on the lower ventral/brisket region, indicating a localized lesion or growth with distinct textural disruption compared to the surrounding pelage.
